notes.title: RELEASE: Different shades of Drake
notes.content:
[h1]The latest expansion focused around ELEANOR’S husband is here![/h1]

In addition to portraying DRAKE as a cuckold in the scenes involving William, this extension will also present him in a contrasting light, showcasing him as a dominant alpha male. In this scenario, he will be seen relishing Eleanor as his cherished prize, with her provocatively dressed in a tantalizing cheerleader outfit. This scene will take place in a communal changing room, adding an element of voyeurism as they won’t have the privacy of being alone, allowing for an intriguing mix of vulnerability and power dynamics.

That’s hot, but we got even more. Beyond these two compelling storylines, we have ambitious plans to raise the tension by incorporating the 6th LEVEL of relationship sex scenes. These scenes are designed to deepen the emotional connections and explore the intricate dynamics between the characters, to underline ELEANOR’S slutty nature. There will be repeatable intimate scenes specifically crafted for both WILLIAM and BEN, providing a nuanced exploration of their desires and kinks.

Additionally, we will introduce an extra scene dedicated to capturing a heartwarming and satisfying conclusion to the relationship journey between ELEANOR and DRAKE. This scene will aim to encapsulate a sense of ultimate fulfillment and happiness, leaving a lasting impression on the audience and bringing their story arc to a gratifying close.

notes.content:
[h2]DIFFERENT SHADES OF DRAKE[/h2]

So far, we’ve released EXPANSION 1: Marina’s secrets and right now, we’re working on a second update called DIFFERENT SHADES OF DRAKE. 

In addition to showcasing DRAKE as a [b]cuckold [/b]in the scenes involving William, this extension will also portray him as a dominant [b]alpha male[/b] who enjoys having Eleanor as his prize, dressed in a sultry cheerleader outfit in a shared changing room (where they won’t be alone). notes.title: IT'S HERE! EXPANSION 1: Marina's secret
notes.content:
Today we’re releasing the first expansion, called MARINA'S SECRET. This update will delve deeper into the character of MARINA, who was previously sidelined in the game's first version. Now, players will have even more opportunities to explore her past and indulge in their kinks together with ELEANOR.

[h2]SO WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?[/h2]

- A main plot line centered around MARINA, consisting of 5 scenes that culminate in a wild orgy

- The introduction of LEVEL 6 interactions brings a new level of intensity, with repeatable sex scenes featuring MARINA in two distinct and daring locations. 

[h2]CONTENT COUNT[/h2]

- 10 mesmerizing sex animations from 2 unique angles
- Approximately 130 beautifully rendered static images

Soon we will reveal the content of EXPANSION 2 called “Different shades of Drake”.

notes.title: Release date
notes.content:
Finally, we're ready to fly!
[h2]I officially confirm that we are releasing ELEANOR IN MIAMI on STEAM on 27 of September 2024.[/h2]

Please WISHLIST ELEANOR if you would like to be notified about the release. We plan to offer 10% off for the first week of sales.

[h2]MARINA EXPANSION[/h2]

We're already developing the first update, which will be exclusively dedicated to MARINA. Her current role in the game isn't as significant as we originally planned - with the new content we're going to add soon, her story will be much more enjoyable. As some of you may already know, MARINA is a character from our previous game called ADRIANE AND OLIVER, and she appears in MIAMI after the events of the ADRIANE game. With the aid of her parents, she tries to change her life and start living decent, but... having Eleanor around isn't always something that lets you forget about your dirty past and move forward. Ladies and gentlemen - fasten your seatbelts because we're going to have a first sixsome in MIAMI.

Next to the MARINA quest line, we'll introduce LEVEL 6 actions to the daily schedule - hot and repeatable sex scenes in two various locations. In further updates to the game, we plan to present such interactions to all already-present characters.
